title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_the_third_frank_belknap_long_science_fiction_megap_by_frank_belknap_long_2cd23 (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_the_third_frank_belknap_long_science_fiction_megap_by_frank_belknap_long_2cd23' is identified as malicious software.
